legal_context.subject: Maintenance in matrimonial and family matters
legal_context.purpose: Provides guidelines for consistency in deciding applications for maintenance and interim maintenance.
legal_context.important_note: The judgment does not prescribe a fixed mathematical formula for determining maintenance.

overlapping_jurisdictions.summary: Different statutes may provide independent and distinct remedies for maintenance or interim maintenance. Courts should consider previous proceedings and orders so that overlapping claims and amounts are appropriately addressed.
rag_use: Ask whether the applicant has filed or received maintenance orders in another proceeding.
Avoid treating every statutory route as an isolated claim.

interim_maintenance.summary: The judgment addresses the need for timely disposal of interim maintenance applications and lays down procedural directions intended to reduce delays.
rag_use: Explain that interim maintenance is distinct from final maintenance.
Help users understand that courts consider financial circumstances and relevant facts when deciding interim maintenance.

criteria_for_determining_maintenance.summary: There is no straightjacket formula for determining the amount of maintenance. The court must consider the facts and circumstances of each case.
factors: Reasonable needs of the wife and dependent children
Independent income and property of the claimant
Income and financial capacity of the respondent
Standard of living enjoyed during the marriage
Whether the claimant had to sacrifice employment or career opportunities for family responsibilities
Reasonable additional education or training expenses where relevant
Other relevant facts and circumstances of the case
rag_use: Explain factors that may be relevant when discussing maintenance.
Generate structured questions for case intake.
Support transparent planning estimates without presenting a guaranteed court amount.

children.summary: Maintenance-related assessment may take into account the reasonable needs and expenses of dependent children.
factors: Reasonable additional training or coaching expenses where applicable

affidavit_of_assets_and_liabilities.summary: The Supreme Court directed disclosure of relevant financial information through an affidavit of assets and liabilities in maintenance proceedings.
rag_use: Guide users on information they may need to collect.
Help identify missing financial information before human legal review.

previous_maintenance_proceedings.summary: Parties should disclose previous maintenance proceedings and orders. Courts should consider previous orders when determining subsequent maintenance claims, including appropriate adjustment or set-off where applicable.
rag_use: Ask whether another maintenance case has already been filed.
Ask whether a maintenance order has already been passed.
Flag possible overlapping maintenance proceedings for human/legal review.

date_from_which_maintenance_is_awarded.summary: The Supreme Court directed that maintenance should ordinarily be awarded from the date of filing of the application.
date_from_which_maintenance_is_awarded.important_note: This is a judicial guideline from Rajnesh v. Neha and should be presented with its case citation rather than as a universal statutory formula.

enforcement.summary: The judgment provides directions concerning enforcement and execution of maintenance orders.
rag_use: Explain that obtaining a maintenance order and enforcing that order are separate practical stages.
Direct users toward appropriate legal or court assistance when an existing order is not being complied with.

final_directions.summary: The Supreme Court issued consolidated directions intended to improve consistency, transparency and timely resolution of maintenance proceedings.

application_to_alimony_plus.calculator_rule: Do not convert the listed factors into a fixed legal formula or guaranteed maintenance amount.
application_to_alimony_plus.estimate_rule: Any planning estimate must clearly state its assumptions, limitations and uncertainty.
application_to_alimony_plus.human_review: Questions involving legal entitlement, conflicting proceedings, interpretation of facts or enforcement should be escalated for appropriate human/legal review.
